reviews.text: Finally found a room at the Outset Collection but the prices were surprisingly high for a last-minute booking, yet the comfort of the bed and the unique design features made it totally worth the extra cost. The 25th brand in the lineup, the 8th one focused on lifestyle, with the debut happening towards the end of 2025, and Slackline Moab and the ACME Hotel in Chicago were the first to go. They're developing 60+ Outset hotels as we speak and future locations will span the United States and Canada, so I was just lucky to catch one before they filled up. Quickly checked in and got a great room assignment, but I noticed some locations lack standard full-service amenities such as complimentary breakfast. Then I realized the best part is that yes, the Outset Collection fully participates in the Hilton Honors loyalty program, making my points stack up nicely.

The Outset Collection fully participates in the Hilton Honors loyalty program and the rooms are super comfortable, but the design feels a bit too raw for my taste. Luckily, a front desk agent noticed I was stressed and personally escorted me to my room to explain everything, which made the whole experience so much better.

Ever wonder what the buzz is about with Hilton's 25th brand, specifically their 8th for the lifestyle market? First locations came online in the latter part of 2025 and the first ones were Slackline Moab and ACME Hotel Chicago. The design felt a bit too industrial for my taste but the room was clean enough for a quick stay. They don't have a full-service breakfast so you need to eat out but the vibe and comfort were great. The brand is growing into locations across the US and Canada so just be ready for the noise on Friday night.

The staff went above and beyond to make my stay feel special from the moment I walked through the door. The room rates were surprisingly reasonable for such high-end design, though the lack of a complimentary breakfast at some locations is a bit of a letdown, but the overall experience was still fantastic.

The front desk staff was incredibly welcoming and helpful with our family needs. While the rooms were priced fairly for the quality and the beds were super comfortable, the lack of a full-service breakfast was a bit surprising. The location is convenient for getting around the city, though it is not right in the middle of the tourist district. Overall, the service was fantastic and made us feel like valued guests at Hilton's 25th brand, specifically their 8th for the lifestyle market.

the rooms are actually pretty nice but honestly the beds felt a bit firm for my liking. food prices were decent and the vibe was great but the coffee quality just wasn't there. overall the hotel quality felt a bit rushed since some locations lack standard full-service amenities such as complimentary breakfast. we are a big family so the 25th brand in the lineup, the 8th one focused on lifestyle, was a big deal for our reunion planning. the design features are super cool but the cleanliness in the hallway was definitely off. still the facilities were comfortable enough for everyone to relax after the long drive.
I wanted to love this but the location was just okay.

The room was spotless and surprisingly comfortable despite the modern, sparse design. I expected a basic stay as a new brand, but using my discount code got me an unexpected suite upgrade. Hilton's 25th brand, specifically their 8th for the lifestyle market.

Look, the cleaning wasn't great but the design features are actually stunning. The location is really convenient for getting around town. The tech gadgets in the room are neutral but the prices were surprisingly good. The rooms are generally okay, the layout is a bit cramped, but the bed was super comfy. The staff was super friendly and the Hilton Honors program definitely works here.
The staff were genuinely kind and super helpful.
the rooms are packed with killer design details, feel super spacious for the price, and the vibe is just perfect.

the room design was so dreamy and the price was totally worth it for a getaway. the staff just made us feel so special from start to finish. we loved how hilton honors worked here even though there was no free breakfast.
the staff was so accommodating when i just walked in without a reservation.

Heads up to anyone planning a stay: this brand is so new the launch kicked off in late 2025. Because of the street traffic and that loud HVAC system, this meant I spent hours tossing and turning in the dark. So I woke up exhausted with no complimentary breakfast to fix the damage from the noise. Yes, the Outset Collection fully participates in the Hilton Honors loyalty program and the design feels modern with high quality finishes.

the rooms are super comfy and honestly feel like a proper upgrade from standard stays, plus everything just works perfectly. the location is right in the middle of the action so getting around is a breeze. honestly i just wish the breakfast buffet wasn't missing from the list since some spots don't even have it, but hey you get what you pay for.

The 25th brand in the lineup, the 8th one focused on lifestyle, debuted with the Slackline Moab and ACME Hotel Chicago in late 2025, and while there are over 60 Outset hotels currently in development to expand across the US and Canada, the design enthusiasm is undeniable as first impressions of the exterior and lobby aesthetic, notably the mid-century modern materials and lush color palettes in particular, lead ultimately to a visually stunning experience.

honestly the room was spotless, the vibe felt fresh, and the bed was super comfy compared to my usual stays. upon testing the front desk staff were super helpful and quick to check me in even though i was an early guest at this hilton's 25th brand, specifically their 8th for the lifestyle market. however, the app had some lag issues resulting in a slow check-in process, and it's a shame they lack standard full-service amenities such as complimentary breakfast since properties started launching in late 2025. the location is great for exploring the area, and with plans include spreading out across the US and Canada, they're developing 60+ Outset hotels as we speak so it won't be long before there's one near you. overall the sleep quality was excellent and the carbonara was absolutely divine.
The carbonara was absolutely divine.
